_note: Curated names, stages and reasons for the recommended sites, from docs/recommendations.md. Numbers are not stored here: the map takes every number from web/data/results.json and candidates.geojson. 'also' lists neighbouring candidates at the same spot (within 40 m) that the model may pick instead after a rerun; pipeline/name_sites.py gives the site's name to whichever of them is selected. Candidate ids follow the order in which the model generates candidates, so a rerun can renumber them. 'pos' therefore stores the position (lon, lat) of the cid and of every 'also' id, from data/derived/candidates.parquet: name_sites.py stops if the selected candidate it would name is more than 15 m from the position stored for its id. Building names follow the model's own labels (for example Owen G. Glenn Building).

city.label: City Campus
city.summary_template: {k_words} docks put {share} of about {arrivals} daily cyclist arrivals within a short walk.

sites.name: Grafton Road frontage at Engineering and the Business School
sites.why: The east gateway from the Grafton Gully cycleway and the Domain, beside Engineering and the Owen G. Glenn Building, two of the campus’s biggest draws. An open rack is already mapped here. The ground slopes, so the station needs the flattest bay nearby.

sites.name: Symonds Street frontage at Hiwa and the Science Centre
sites.why: Reaches Hiwa and Science Centre 301 and 303 from the Symonds Street side, on open ground with a gentle slope (2.8%). The card-access bike shed beside Hiwa is close by, so this dock would mainly serve visitors and short stays.

sites.name: Service lane between the General Library and the Old Choral Hall
sites.why: Reaches the General Library, the Old Choral Hall, Biology, Commerce A and the Thomas Building within a short walk, so it covers most of the northern precinct. It is a quiet service lane with no mapped lamps, so check lighting and vehicle access on site.

sites.name: Symonds Street southern gateway, by Architecture and Planning
sites.why: One of the busiest approaches in the model: riders from homes near the campus and from the south and west are routed past here. It serves the Science Centre, Architecture and Hiwa from a footpath with mapped street lamps, bus stops and shops around it.

sites.name: Wynyard Street by Social Sciences, Humanities and the Fale
sites.why: Covers the eastern arts and social-science buildings. The Building 201 store nearby needs a Campus Card; this dock would not.

sites.name: Waterloo Quadrant by the Fisher Building and the Davis Law Library
sites.why: Reaches the Fisher Building, the Davis Law Library and the other Waterloo Quadrant and Eden Crescent buildings, which no other dock reaches. It is the weakest of the six for eyes on the street, with no mapped lamps or shops close by, so treat it as optional.

grafton.label: Grafton Campus
grafton.summary_template: {k_words} docks put {share} of about {arrivals} daily cyclist arrivals within a short walk.

sites.name: Park Avenue, at the main Medical and Health Sciences building
sites.why: About half of Grafton’s arrivals end within reach, on the approach from Park Road and the hospital. The card-access shed under Building 505 serves regular riders; this dock would serve visitors, clinicians and students without a card.

sites.name: Park Road frontage by the Boyle Crescent building
sites.why: Flat and busy, with shops and bus stops on Park Road. Fewer modelled riders pass here than on Park Avenue; it earns its place by reaching the Park Road and Boyle Crescent buildings.

sites.name: Grafton Road near 89–93 Grafton Road
sites.why: Serves the northern Grafton buildings only. Two docks already cover most of the campus, so build this one only if those buildings need their own.

newmarket.label: Newmarket Campus
newmarket.summary_template: {k_words} docks put {share} of about {arrivals} daily cyclist arrivals within a short walk.

sites.name: The campus core path, beside the main Khyber Pass Road buildings
sites.why: Three quarters of Newmarket’s arrivals end within reach. It has a gentle slope (3.4%) and open sightlines, and it appears to be University land, which would avoid road-reserve consent; confirm on site.

sites.name: Khyber Pass Road entrance at the Ray Meyer Building
sites.why: The street-facing dock for riders on Khyber Pass Road, serving Structures and the Ray Meyer Building. The modelled point is on a slope, so the station should go on the flattest spot at the entrance.

sites.name: Suiter Street at the School of Exercise, Sport and Rehabilitation Science
sites.why: Serves the School of Exercise, Sport and Rehabilitation Science and the eastern buildings, with shops and cafés around it.
